displayName: RTD stream: no new batch for 30 minutes

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="realtime-load" AND (textPayload:"STREAM_STALE" OR textPayload:"STREAM_MISSING")

documentation.content: The poller VM has not delivered a 15-minute batch for over 30 minutes. Check `sudo systemctl status whyline-stream` and `journalctl CONTAINER_NAME=whyline-stream` over IAP SSH, the RT_STREAM_HEARTBEAT log lines, and the outbox size. Runbook: docs/technical/plans/realtime-stop-visits.md section 7.
